title: Branch on optional values without panics
summary: Use concise conditional matching and an early return for missing input. Test both present and absent paths, including an empty string.

optional.clue: Type representing either one unsigned 32-bit integer or its absence

conditional.clue: Construct matching the present variant without an exhaustive match expression

present.clue: Option variant wrapping a present numeric value

otherwise.clue: Keyword introducing the fallback when the if-let pattern does not match

binding.clue: Keyword beginning a refutable local binding with a diverging fallback

fallback.clue: Keyword introducing the diverging branch of let-else

early.clue: Keyword leaving width immediately for missing input

length.clue: Method counting the bytes of the present string slice

absent.clue: Option variant representing missing numeric input

equal.clue: Macro checking width for absent input
